subject: MerchantEdge — security discovery recap & deliverables
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@merchantedge.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: sam.ortiz@merchantedge.com, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: MerchantEdge security discovery — follow-up and asks

Hi Jasmine / Aditya,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and a list of items we need from Redwood to evaluate: 

Pain points & goals
- Audit log retention: we currently retain high-fidelity logs for 30 days and aggregated logs for 12 months; compliance wants a sample export and confirmation Redwood can support 6–12mo retention for audit purposes.
- SOC 2: we're evaluating vendors that already have SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent evidence and a clear remediation/roadmap).
- DPA & data residency: we need a DPA template + redlines and confirmation of where logs are stored (US-only for now).
- Pen test evidence: would like a summary of the most recent pen test and any public CVEs addressed in the last 12 months.

Questions / Asks from Redwood
1) SOC 2 artifacts or a summary document describing scope and date.
2) A small sample of auditlog exports (CSV) and a short note on retention configuration.
3) DPA template with any common redlines you accept.
4) Pen test summary or recent security findings and remediation notes.

Tentative timeline from our procurement side: internal security review completes by 2026-08-25. If possible, please send the items above by 2026-08-20 so we can slot Redwood into the next procurement review.

Thanks — happy to jump back on a call after your send.

Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Ops, MerchantEdge
alex.chen@merchantedge.com
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@merchantedge.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MerchantEdge security discovery — follow-up and asks

Alex — great speaking with you and thanks for the clear list. Summary and next steps from our side below.

What we heard
- You need SOC 2 scope and evidence to satisfy procurement.
- Audit logs: sample export + confirmation of retention/config is required (target: 6–12 months archival availability).
- Legal needs a DPA + preferred redlines.
- Pen test summary to show recent findings/remediations.

What Redwood will deliver (owners & timeline)
- SOC 2 summary and artifact index (high level): jasmine_liu — 3 business days (target 2026-08-17). Attachment: SOC2_summary_v1.pdf (stub).
- Audit log sample + retention note: aditya_rao — deliver by 2026-08-21. Attachment: auditlog_sample_merchantedge.csv (stub). We will include a one-page note on how retention tiers and exports work.
- DPA template + redlines: marissa_cole (legal) — will provide an initial redline and DocuSign path by 2026-08-20. Attachment: DPA_redlines_merchantedge.docx (stub).
- Pen test summary: security team export — 2026-08-18. Attachment: pen_test_summary.txt (stub).

Proposed next call
- Compliance walkthrough + question session: propose 2026-08-24 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET. Please confirm availability.

Internal notes
- We should confirm data residency for audit log exports (US-only as requested) and whether they need a long-term cold archive option.
- Flagging potential recommended flow: pilot with 6mo retention on dedicated bucket, then extend to 12mo if procurement requires.

I'll attach the docs to this thread as we release them. If any of these dates are too aggressive, let me know and we can adjust.

— Jasmine Liu
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@merchantedge.com>, Samantha Ortiz <sam.ortiz@merchantedge.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MerchantEdge security discovery — follow-up and asks

On Sat, Aug 14, 2026 at 3:02 PM Alex Chen <alex.chen@merchantedge.com> wrote:
> Pain points & goals
> - Audit log retention: we currently retain high-fidelity logs for 30 days and aggregated logs for 12 months; compliance wants a sample export and confirmation Redwood can support 6–12mo retention for audit purposes.
> - SOC 2: we're evaluating vendors that already have SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent evidence and a clear remediation/roadmap).
>
Thanks for the recap — technical notes and proposed clarifications from my side: 

Technical clarifications
- Export format: we can provide CSV or Parquet exports; CSV sample attached. The sample contains event timestamps, request ids, model id, route, user_id hash, and event type. We'll strip PII fields before sending.
- Retention tiers: Redwood supports hot KV cache + short-term hot logs (30–90d) and cold archival for up to multi-year retention using object storage. For compliance, we can configure a dedicated archival bucket scoped to the customer and set lifecycle rules to keep unaggregated logs for 6–12mo.
- Data residency: we can guarantee US-only storage if they pin the deployment to a US region — will confirm exact region mapping in the audit note.
- Pen test: we'll share a summary; full reports are controlled but we can provide redacted findings and remediation timelines.

Proposed POC approach
1) Provide SOC2 summary + auditlog sample by 2026-08-17 (SOC2) / 2026-08-21 (audit sample).
2) Run a 2-week retention pilot where we configure a dedicated archival bucket and share access to a small export for MerchantEdge to validate.
3) Legal review DPA in parallel.

I'll prepare the retention config snippet and workflow and drop it in the shared drive link.

— Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
From: Samantha Ortiz <sam.ortiz@merchantedge.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@merchantedge.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MerchantEdge security discovery — follow-up and asks

Jasmine / Aditya — thanks, that timeline looks fine. A handful of quick confirmations: 

- SOC2 summary by 8/17: yes, we'll use that to triage scope with our security team.
- Audit log sample by 8/21: CSV is fine, please strip any customer PII and include mapping for event columns.
- DPA redlines by 8/20: we'll review and push any nonstandard items back to you. If possible, please include a short cover note that explains any clauses you do not accept (helps speed legal review).
- Pen test summary: redacted summary is fine.

Please send DocuSign link for DPA when ready and confirm time for the compliance walkthrough (8/24 10am PT is good for Alex and me).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement will slot Redwood into the vendor shortlist if docs arrive on the dates above.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Senior Security Manager, MerchantEdge
sam.ortiz@merchantedge.com
